title: Opium, cocaine and the sporting life in Newark
summary: He says there was no marijuana then, only hop and cocaine, and describes pimps with opium pipes who tried to break him in.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I see. Were people smoking marijuana in those days?
No marijuana.
No?
Hop.
Hop? Smoking hop.
Yeah. And then they had a -- sniffing cocaine.
Uh hunh.
There wasn't no such thing as marijuana. I didn't hear of marijuana until after Louis Armstrong got on
the scene, you know?
Uh hunh.
See, and then they used to call it loco weed, or something like that. They used to -- the cows used to use that out west and go crazy about it, you know?
Well, cocaine was very expensive, were black people sniffing cocaine, too?
Sniffing cocaine.
Yeah.
Johnny Vikal. He had a big act on that and he did very well with that. And what he used was, 'Chinatown' for his music, you know, and he did a dope fiend act.
(unintelligible)
There were a lot of songs about that. About dope.
(unintelligible) -- blacks using cocaine at that time because it was very expensive. Nothing but the sports.
Oh, the blacks that were using the cocaine were the sports. The pimps and the --
Yeah. Well, you see, when I was in Newark, Newark was a sporting town.
Uh hunh.

There was a hundred and one girls in there. Well, these pimps were all around there, some of them had five and six girls. Well, they had a pipe. A hop pipe they called Black Diamond, they used to call Black Diamond. They tried to get me to come up there and use that pipe, but you know, there was a kid, they wanted to break me in to that. Because I was young and, I mean, I liked them because, you know, I'd give them anything they wanted when they come into the cabaret, like if they wanted a certain song or something like that, I'd play it.

Well, anyhow, what happened is that I've been up there and I've seen them and to, and they used it, and they thought it was a great thing. As I say, they were hop fiends and they only used fruit and milk, you know what I mean? And they were big timers, so they thought, you know?
Uh hunh.

Like the Sioux Indians or somebody, see. Anyhow, I never went for that, because, in fact I didn't even smoke any more cigarettes after that episode with my father. You know what I mean? I've been smoking cigars and everything ever since that.
